contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ I[IMP CAES] DOMIT A[VG GERM COS XI CENS POT P

A very worn and damaged Roman silver denarius of Domitian [AD81-96]. Reece period: Period 4. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: I[IMP CAES] DOMIT A[VG GERM COS XI CENS POT P P].Reverse description: Emperor riding right, holding shield, trampling & striking with spear a fallen German
